detail.longDescription: Is it possible to search for a specific string/text in a source files and in particular branch using the GitHub UI? Even after selecting the release branch, when I search for a string or try to view the changes made in that branch inside my repository, the results don't show to the release branch. As a result, I am unable to find changes that were made specifically in the release branch. Note: My search specific to UI, Repoistory and branch. 2)If I change the default branch from Main to my branch(release) then it shows.
